author: ETA PRIME
description:
Do you miss the classic Xbox 360 Metro Dashboard? In this video, we are bringing pure nostalgia to modern hardware using DashX360! This incredible fan-made project allows you to run a recreation of the iconic Xbox 360 Metro UI directly on your Windows 11 desktop, laptop, or handheld device (like the Legion Go or ROG Ally).

I'll walk you through the entire setup process, from downloading the launcher to customizing your layout. We cover everything from enabling full controller support to importing your Steam library so you can launch modern games directly from the dashboard. Plus, I'll show you how to download real, classic Xbox 360 themes from the Internet Archive and add custom box art to your games using SteamGridDB!
